description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart representing the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref across three primary categories and their subcategories, with 3 slices in the inner ring and 13 slices in the outer ring. In the inner ring, “Virtual Characters” is shown in medium blue and occupies roughly about two thirds of the circle (≈65–70%), “Real Characters” is shown in light green at about a quarter (≈20–25%), and “Custom Characters” is shown in light pink at around a tenth (≈10–15%). The outer ring breaks these down into subcategories: the blue “Virtual Characters” portion is split into five light-blue slices labeled “Comic Characters” (the largest outer slice, roughly ≈35–40% of the full circle), “Game Characters” (≈15–18%), “Movie Characters” (≈10–12%), “Novel Characters” (≈7–9%), and “Teleplay Characters” (≈6–8%); the green “Real Characters” portion is split into seven light-green slices labeled “Influencers” (the largest green slice, ≈4–6%), “Actors” (≈2–4%), “Musicians” (≈2–4%), “Writers” (≈2–4%), “Athletes” (≈2–3%), “Artists” (≈1–3%), and “Scientists” (≈1–3%); and the pink “Custom Characters” portion appears as a single light-pink outer slice (≈10–15%) without additional subcategory labels. There is no separate legend and no numeric percentage labels inside slices; categories are indicated by direct text labels placed on or around the rings, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
